manual_review.arms_modes: OFF and ON; plain, Store, Accumulate independently
manual_review.barriers: publish0 -> retire0 -> publish1 -> retire1; no shared stores inside reader intervals
manual_review.preload: Full source/PTX A/DM preload and full X shared preload preserved. Both OFF/ON SASS interleave independent LDSM and math; literal all-register-loads-before-first-MMA is false for both.
manual_review.hot_modes_difference: plain=Store; Accumulate only renames address-carry P1/P2 at0x1a00/0x1a10. Full kernels/epilogues are not identical.
manual_review.per_slot_recurrence: k32=0..7: scale=FP32(dA*dB); sum=FFMA(scale,FP32(IMMA_output),sum); sum=FFMA(mA,sB,sum). Phase outputs return to incoming accumulator registers; roots zero.

epilogues.Accumulate: 64 LDG.U16 -> exact BF16 expand -> FP32 FADD -> BF16 RN -> STG.U16, same address-register versions

manual_review.performance_tradeoff: OFF prefetches half1 Y duringhalf0 math; ON loads Y within eachphase and loses that overlap. Smaller footprint does not imply speedup or isolate I-cache cost.
